title: सप्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Narada describes Indra's radiant hall, built by Indra himself, where he sits with Shachi among the Maruts and gods. Royal sages, great seers, Gandharvas and apsarases attend him there.
summary.kn: ಇಂದ್ರನೇ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿದ, ಶಚಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮರುತ್ತರು ದೇವತೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಅವನು ಕುಳಿತಿರುವ ತೇಜೋಮಯ ಸಭೆಯನ್ನು ನಾರದರು ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ರಾಜರ್ಷಿಗಳು, ಮಹರ್ಷಿಗಳು, ಗಂಧರ್ವರು, ಅಪ್ಸರೆಯರು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನನ್ನು ಸೇವಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: नारद इन्द्र की तेजोमय सभा का वर्णन करते हैं, जिसे स्वयं इन्द्र ने बनाया और जहाँ वे शची के साथ मरुतों और देवताओं के बीच बैठते हैं। राजर्षि, महर्षि, गन्धर्व और अप्सराएँ वहाँ उनकी सेवा करते हैं।
summary.te: ఇంద్రుడే నిర్మించిన, శచీదేవితో మరుత్తులు, దేవతల మధ్య ఆయన కూర్చునే తేజోమయ సభను నారదుడు వర్ణిస్తాడు. రాజర్షులు, మహర్షులు, గంధర్వులు, అప్సరసలు అక్కడ ఆయనను సేవిస్తారు.
summary.ta: இந்திரனே அமைத்த, ஶசியுடன் மருத்துக்களும் தேவர்களும் சூழ அவன் அமரும் ஒளிமிக்க ஸபையை நாரதர் வர்ணிக்கிறார். ராஜரிஷிகளும் மகரிஷிகளும் கந்தர்வர்களும் அப்ஸரஸ்களும் அங்கு அவனைச் சேவிக்கிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: ഇന്ദ്രൻ തന്നെ പണിത, പ്രകാശമുള്ള ഇന്ദ്രസഭയെ നാരദൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു; അവിടെ ശചിയോടൊപ്പം മരുത്തുക്കൾക്കും ദേവന്മാർക്കും ഇടയിൽ ഇന്ദ്രൻ ഇരിക്കുന്നു. രാജർഷിമാരും മഹർഷിമാരും ഗന്ധർവന്മാരും അപ്സരസ്സുകളും അവിടെ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ സേവിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 2.7; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Apr 19 2006

verses.text: नारद उवाच

meaning.en: Narada said:

verses.text:
शक्रस्य तु सभा दिव्या भास्वरा कर्मभिर्जिता ।
स्वयं शक्रेण कौरव्य निर्मितार्कसमप्रभा ॥

meaning.en: Shakra's hall is heavenly and shining, won by his deeds; Shakra himself made it, O Kaurava, and it glows like the sun.

verses.text:
विस्तीर्णा योजनशतं शतमध्यर्धमायता ।
वैहायसी कामगमा पञ्चयोजनमुच्छ्रिता ॥

meaning.en: It is a hundred and fifty yojanas long and a hundred wide, moves through the air at will, and rises five yojanas high.

verses.text:
जराशोकक्लमापेता निरातङ्का शिवा शुभा ।
वेश्मासनवती रम्या दिव्यपादपशोभिता ॥

meaning.en: It is free from old age, grief and weariness, without fear, auspicious and fair, with rooms and seats, lovely, adorned with heavenly trees.

verses.text:
तस्यां देवेश्वरः पार्थ सभायां परमासने ।
आस्ते शच्या महेन्द्राण्या श्रिया लक्ष्म्या च भारत ॥

meaning.en: In that hall, Partha, the lord of the gods sits on the highest seat with Shachi, the great Indra's queen, and with Shri and Lakshmi.

verses.text:
बिभ्रद्वपुरनिर्देश्यं किरीटी लोहिताङ्गदः ।
विरजोम्बरश्चित्रमाल्यो ह्रीकीर्तिद्युतिभिः सह ॥

meaning.en: Wearing a form beyond description, crowned, with red armlets, spotless garments and varied garlands, he sits with Modesty, Fame and Radiance.

verses.text:
तस्यामुपासते नित्यं महात्मानं शतक्रतुम् ।
मरुतः सर्वतो राजन्सर्वे च गृहमेधिनः ।
सिद्धा देवर्षयश्चैव साध्या देवगणास्तथा ॥

meaning.en: There the Maruts always wait upon the great Shatakratu, O king, and so do all the householders, the Siddhas, the divine seers, the Sadhyas and the hosts of gods.

verses.text:
एते सानुचराः सर्वे दिव्यरूपाः स्वलंकृताः ।
उपासते महात्मानं देवराजमरिंदमम् ॥

meaning.en: All these, with their followers, in heavenly forms and richly adorned, attend the great king of the gods, subduer of enemies.

verses.text:
तथा देवर्षयः सर्वे पार्थ शक्रमुपासते ।
अमला धूतपाप्मानो दीप्यमाना इवाग्नयः ।
तेजस्विनः सोमयुजो विपापा विगतक्लमाः ॥

meaning.en: The divine seers likewise, Partha, attend Shakra, spotless, their sins shaken off, blazing like fires, radiant, drinkers of soma, free from sin and weariness.

verses.text:
पराशरः पर्वतश्च तथा सावर्णिगालवौ ।
शङ्खश्च लिखितश्चैव तथा गौरशिरा मुनिः ॥

meaning.en: Parashara, Parvata, Savarni, Galava, Shankha, Likhita and the sage Gaurashiras;

verses.text:
दुर्वासाश्च दीर्घतपा याज्ञवल्क्योऽथ भालुकिः ।
उद्दालकः श्वेतकेतुस्तथा शाट्यायनः प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: Durvasa, Dirghatapas, Yajnavalkya, Bhaluki, Uddalaka, Shvetaketu and the lord Shatyayana;

verses.text:
हविष्मांश्च गविष्ठश्च हरिश्चन्द्रश्च पार्थिवः ।
हृद्यश्चोदरशाण्डिल्यः पाराशर्यः कृषीवलः ॥

meaning.en: Havishman, Gavishtha, King Harishchandra, Hridya, Udarashandilya, Parasharya and Krishivala;

verses.text:
वातस्कन्धो विशाखश्च विधाता काल एव च ।
अनन्तदन्तस्त्वष्टा च विश्वकर्मा च तुम्बुरुः ॥

meaning.en: Vatashandha, Vishakha, Vidhata, Kala, Anantadanta, Tvashta, Vishvakarma and Tumburu;

verses.text:
अयोनिजा योनिजाश्च वायुभक्षा हुताशिनः ।
ईशानं सर्वलोकस्य वज्रिणं समुपासते ॥

meaning.en: those not born of a womb and those born of one, wind-eaters and those who live on offerings, all attend the wielder of the thunderbolt, lord of every world.

verses.text:
सहदेवः सुनीथश्च वाल्मीकिश्च महातपाः ।
समीकः सत्यवांश्चैव प्रचेताः सत्यसंगरः ॥

meaning.en: Sahadeva, Sunitha, Valmiki of great austerity, Shamika, Satyavan, Prachetas who keeps his word;

verses.text:
मेधातिथिर्वामदेवः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः ।
मरुत्तश्च मरीचिश्च स्थाणुश्चात्रिर्महातपाः ॥

meaning.en: Medhatithi, Vamadeva, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Marutta, Marichi, Sthanu and the greatly ascetic Atri;

verses.text:
कक्षीवान्गौतमस्तार्क्ष्यस्तथा वैश्वानरो मुनिः ।
मुनिः कालकवृक्षीय आश्राव्योऽथ हिरण्यदः ।
संवर्तो देवहव्यश्च विष्वक्सेनश्च वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: Kakshivan, Gautama, Tarkshya, the sage Vaishvanara, the sage Kalakavrikshiya, Ashravya, Hiranyada, Samvarta, Devahavya and the mighty Vishvaksena.

verses.text:
दिव्या आपस्तथौषध्यः श्रद्धा मेधा सरस्वती ।
अर्थो धर्मश्च कामश्च विद्युतश्चापि पाण्डव ॥

meaning.en: The heavenly waters and plants, Faith, Insight, Sarasvati, Wealth, Dharma, Desire and lightning also are there, Pandava.

verses.text:
जलवाहास्तथा मेघा वायवः स्तनयित्नवः ।
प्राची दिग्यज्ञवाहाश्च पावकाः सप्तविंशतिः ॥

meaning.en: So are the water-bearing clouds, the winds, thunder, the eastern quarter, the sacrificial carriers and the twenty-seven fires.

verses.text:
अग्नीषोमौ तथेन्द्राग्नी मित्रोऽथ सवितार्यमा ।
भगो विश्वे च साध्याश्च शुक्रो मन्थी च भारत ॥

meaning.en: Agni and Soma, Indra and Agni, Mitra, Savita, Aryaman, Bhaga, the Vishvedevas and the Sadhyas, and Shukra and Manthin, O Bharata.

verses.text:
यज्ञाश्च दक्षिणाश्चैव ग्रहाः स्तोभाश्च सर्वशः ।
यज्ञवाहाश्च ये मन्त्राः सर्वे तत्र समासते ॥

meaning.en: Sacrifices and sacrificial fees, planets and the praise-chants of every kind, and all the mantras that carry the sacrifice, sit there together.

verses.text:
तथैवाप्सरसो राजन्गन्धर्वाश्च मनोरमाः ।
नृत्यवादित्रगीतैश्च हास्यैश्च विविधैरपि ।
रमयन्ति स्म नृपते देवराजं शतक्रतुम् ॥

meaning.en: Likewise the Apsarases and charming Gandharvas, O king, with dance, music, song and many sorts of laughter, entertain Shatakratu, the king of the gods.

verses.text:
स्तुतिभिर्मङ्गलैश्चैव स्तुवन्तः कर्मभिस्तथा ।
विक्रमैश्च महात्मानं बलवृत्रनिषूदनम् ॥

meaning.en: They praise the great slayer of Bala and Vritra with hymns, blessings, tales of his deeds and of his heroic feats.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मराजर्षयः सर्वे सर्वे देवर्षयस्तथा ।
विमानैर्विविधैर्दिव्यैर्भ्राजमानैरिवाग्निभिः ॥

meaning.en: All the Brahmin royal seers and all the divine seers come in many heavenly flying chariots that blaze like fires.

verses.text:
स्रग्विणो भूषिताश्चान्ये यान्ति चायान्ति चापरे ।
बृहस्पतिश्च शुक्रश्च तस्यामाययतुः सह ॥

meaning.en: Some, garlanded and adorned, go away and others come; Brihaspati and Shukra came there together.

verses.text:
एते चान्ये च बहवो यतात्मानो यतव्रताः ।
विमानैश्चन्द्रसंकाशैः सोमवत्प्रियदर्शनाः ।
ब्रह्मणो वचनाद्राजन्भृगुः सप्तर्षयस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: These and many others, self-controlled and firm in their vows, with chariots like the moon and lovely to see like the moon, came there at Brahma's word, O king, as did Bhrigu and the seven seers.

verses.text:
एषा सभा मया राजन्दृष्टा पुष्करमालिनी ।
शतक्रतोर्महाराज याम्यां शृणु ममानघ ॥

meaning.en: This hall of Shatakratu, wreathed in lotus garlands, I have seen, great king; now hear from me about the hall of Yama, O blameless one.
